name: saywise-skills
description: Turn Claude Code, Cowork, Claude Desktop, or Codex sessions into Saywise-ready AI Work story drafts — composed in your voice under an anti-slop style contract — and measure your local AI usage (aggregate-only, Claude Code + Codex CLI). Drafting stays local; you post drafts yourself. Usage stats can be submitted to your Saywise profile via the bundled MCP server, opt-in per run. Hooks (bundled for Claude Code, wireable on Codex CLI) queue story-worthy conversations as sessions end; unattended drafting is opt-in.
